_meta.description: Machine-readable standards registry for the Orthogonal Engineering repository. Every standard has an id, category, rule, enforcement_command, and falsifies_if condition. Query with: python tools/standards_check.py --list

standards.rule: Every truth is derivable
standards.description: All invariant conclusions must be derived from premises via proof steps; no bare assertions.
standards.falsifies_if: A ProofObject exists with empty premises and a non-trivial conclusion

standards.rule: Every derivation is reproducible
standards.description: All computations must be deterministic: PYTHONHASHSEED pinned, no random(), no time.time() in invariant paths.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds non-deterministic call in an invariant path

standards.rule: Every mutation is re-verifiable
standards.description: Every change to AGENT_FEED.md or consent_log.jsonl must be hash-verifiable after the fact.
standards.falsifies_if: python tools/state_witness/generate_feed_entry.py --verify exits non-zero

standards.rule: No authority without proof
standards.description: No check function may return True without constructing a ProofObject with non-empty premises.
standards.falsifies_if: popperian_audit.py reports a domain with success=True but no ProofObject premises

standards.rule: No hidden state
standards.description: All invariant inputs must be explicit parameters; no global mutable state or module-level side effects.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds a 'global' statement in an invariants.py file

standards.rule: No unverifiable dependency
standards.description: No invariant may call external network services, unversioned APIs, or filesystem paths outside REPO_ROOT.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds a network call in an invariants.py file

standards.rule: No economic gatekeeping
standards.description: All tools, tests, and verification scripts must run with stdlib only (no paid API keys required).
standards.falsifies_if: A verification script fails because a paid API key is absent

standards.rule: Every artifact is hash-anchored
standards.description: Every ProofObject carries a SHA-256 proof_hash computed from its rule, premises, and conclusion.
standards.enforcement_command: python -c "from axioms.logic import ProofObject; p = ProofObject('R', ['p'], 'c'); assert len(p.proof_hash) == 64"
standards.falsifies_if: ProofObject.proof_hash is absent, empty, or not 64 hex characters

standards.rule: No float() — Fraction only
standards.description: All numeric computations must use fractions.Fraction for exact arithmetic. float(), math.isclose(), and numpy floating-point are forbidden in domain invariants.
standards.falsifies_if: grep returns any match in invariants.py or implementation.py

standards.rule: All check functions return Tuple[bool, ProofObject]
standards.description: Every public function named check_* must have return type annotation Tuple[bool, ProofObject] and must return exactly that.
standards.falsifies_if: A check_* function returns a bare bool or raises instead of returning ProofObject

standards.rule: All docstrings include 'Falsifies if:' (title-case) AND 'falsifies_if:' (lowercase)
standards.description: Every public function in invariants.py must have both forms in its docstring for CI and human readability.
standards.falsifies_if: popperian_audit.py reports a domain FAIL due to missing falsifies_if

standards.rule: No assert statements — use ProofObject for failures
standards.description: assert statements are forbidden in production code. Failure evidence must be carried in ProofObject.conclusion.
standards.enforcement_command: grep -rn '^[[:space:]]*assert ' src/domains/ axioms/ kernel/ oe_engine/ --include='*.py' | grep -v '/tests/'
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds an assert statement in any non-test production file

standards.rule: No stubs — no pass bodies, no NotImplementedError
standards.description: All public functions must be fully implemented. pass-only bodies and NotImplementedError are forbidden.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds pass or NotImplementedError in a non-test invariants.py

standards.rule: mypy --strict compatible type annotations
standards.description: All Python source files must pass mypy --strict type checking. Config is in mypy.ini.
standards.falsifies_if: mypy --strict reports an error in any production file

standards.rule: All tests runnable with pytest (no side effects at import time)
standards.description: Test files must be importable without side effects. All test functions must be discoverable by pytest.
standards.falsifies_if: pytest --collect-only reports a collection error

standards.rule: Steward role only — detect and report, do not silently mutate
standards.description: Warden agents must not mutate repository state. Executor agents must report changes via ProofObject and consent log.
standards.falsifies_if: An agent mutates files without a corresponding consent log entry

standards.rule: Append-only logs — never delete or rewrite
standards.description: AGENT_FEED.md and pr47_stewardship/witness/consent_log.jsonl are append-only. Existing rows must not be deleted or modified.
standards.falsifies_if: Hash chain verification fails for any existing row

standards.rule: No Recursive Wipe — never rm -rf, shutil.rmtree, or equivalent
standards.description: Any operation that iterates and deletes files is forbidden. See PR #48 social engineering case study.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds a recursive delete call in tool or automation scripts

standards.rule: No defamation — capability comparison only (HAS/DOES_NOT_HAVE/UNKNOWN)
standards.description: AI capability statements must use objective capability claims, not comparative criticism of companies.
standards.falsifies_if: A document contains negative comparative claim about an AI company that is not a capability claim

standards.rule: Consent log entry required before code changes
standards.description: Every coding session must record a SOP-AI-HANDSHAKE-1.0 consent entry before the first code mutation.
standards.falsifies_if: consent_log.jsonl has no entry timestamped within the current session window

standards.rule: Peano gate sequencing — S(0) through S(5), no skipping
standards.description: The AGENT_FEED.md chain uses Peano successor notation. Genesis row S(0) has empty prev_entry_hash. Each subsequent row links to the previous.
standards.falsifies_if: Any row's prev_entry_hash does not equal the previous row's entry_hash

standards.rule: Technical register — not liturgical, poetic, or sacral prose
standards.description: All markdown documentation uses engineering documentation style. Yeshua Standard theological concepts are technical terms, not devotional language.
standards.falsifies_if: A markdown file uses first-person devotional language or poetic cadence in technical sections

standards.rule: Scripture quotations as HTML comments for provenance
standards.description: Scripture references must be wrapped in HTML comments (<!-- -->) so they are present for provenance but not rendered.
standards.falsifies_if: A rendered markdown document displays a scripture quotation outside of a code block or HTML comment

standards.rule: ANTI-NOMINALISM — zero labels without hashed referents
standards.description: Every named concept must have a ProofObject or hash-anchored artifact. Nominal labels with no computation behind them are forbidden.
standards.falsifies_if: A domain module exports a check function whose ProofObject has no premises

standards.rule: ANTI-DOGMA — zero claims without falsification tests
standards.description: Every invariant check must have a corresponding test that exercises the failure path.
standards.enforcement_command: pytest tests/ -q -k 'fail or invalid or broken or tamper or wrong'
standards.falsifies_if: A domain has zero failure-path tests

standards.rule: Domain count is 163 — all domains must have invariants.py with run_all_invariants()
standards.description: 163 domain packages in src/domains/ must each have an invariants.py file with a run_all_invariants() function returning at least 4 checks.
standards.falsifies_if: popperian_audit.py reports fewer than 163 passing domains

standards.rule: State witness write-back is serialized via concurrency group
standards.description: The pr40-canonical-presence.yml workflow must use concurrency group 'state-witness-write' with cancel-in-progress: false to prevent race conditions.
standards.falsifies_if: grep does not find 'state-witness-write' concurrency group in the workflow file

standards.rule: fetch-depth: 0 in all checkout steps that push back to main
standards.description: Shallow clones (fetch-depth: 1) cause non-fast-forward rejections when concurrent pushes arrive. All write-back steps must use fetch-depth: 0.
standards.falsifies_if: grep finds fetch-depth: 1 in a checkout step that precedes a git push

standards.rule: Bot commit message includes [skip ci] to prevent recursion
standards.description: Automated AGENT_FEED.md commits must include [skip ci] in the message to prevent the state-witness workflow from triggering on its own output.
standards.falsifies_if: The automated commit message does not contain '[skip ci]'

standards.rule: AGENT_FEED.md chain is cryptographically intact
standards.description: Every row's prev_entry_hash must equal the previous row's entry_hash. The entry_hash must be SHA-256 of the canonical pipe-delimited payload.
standards.falsifies_if: verify_feed_integrity() returns ok=False

standards.rule: build_feed_entry() returns exactly 8 ledger-schema keys — git_ref excluded
standards.description: The entry dict must contain: timestamp, freeze_hash, merkle_root, invariant_spec_version, source_paths, commit_sha, prev_entry_hash, entry_hash. git_ref is not a ledger column and must not appear.
standards.enforcement_command: python -c "from tools.state_witness.generate_feed_entry import build_feed_entry; e = build_feed_entry(timestamp='T', commit_sha='S'); assert 'git_ref' not in e, 'ghost field present'"
standards.falsifies_if: build_feed_entry() returns a dict that contains the key 'git_ref'

standards.rule: Agent onboarding must use tools/onboard_agent.py to load applicable standards before any code change
standards.falsifies_if: onboard_agent.py exits non-zero for a supported agent on a healthy repo

standards.rule: Context window budget must be checked before reading large directories (tools/context_window_estimator.py)
standards.falsifies_if: context_window_estimator.py exits non-zero or total_tokens is negative

standards.rule: Returning agents must run tools/since_last_session.py to catch up before making changes
standards.falsifies_if: since_last_session.py exits non-zero for a valid row number

standards.rule: arXiv paper metrics must be drawn live from the repo using tools/arxiv_paper_template.py --metrics-json
standards.falsifies_if: arxiv_paper_template.py exits non-zero or domain_count is 0

standards.rule: Repository health must be verified via tools/agent_health_check.py --fast before merging PRs
standards.falsifies_if: agent_health_check.py exits 1 (any fast check fails)

standards.rule: GLOSSARY.md must exist with at least 40 entries
standards.description: The repository must maintain a machine-readable glossary with at minimum 40 term entries covering all Yeshua Standard roles, operators, and architectural patterns.
standards.enforcement_command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; content = Path("GLOSSARY.md").read_text(); rows = [l for l in content.splitlines() if l.startswith("|") and "---" not in l and "Engineering Definition" not in l]; exit(0 if len(rows) >= 40 else 1)"
standards.falsifies_if: GLOSSARY.md does not exist or contains fewer than 40 table data rows

standards.rule: AGENT_CAPABILITIES_MATRIX.md must exist with at least 10 agents
standards.description: The repository must maintain an agent capabilities matrix listing at minimum 10 AI agents with their access, shell, web, context window, and platform file details.
standards.enforcement_command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; content = Path("AGENT_CAPABILITIES_MATRIX.md").read_text(); rows = [l for l in content.splitlines() if l.startswith("|") and "---" not in l and "Agent" not in l]; exit(0 if len(rows) >= 10 else 1)"
standards.falsifies_if: AGENT_CAPABILITIES_MATRIX.md does not exist or lists fewer than 10 agents

standards.rule: CROSS_REPO_INSTRUCTIONS.md must reference all 3 covenant repositories
standards.description: The cross-repo instructions document must reference all three covenant repositories: orthogonal-engineering, sigma-lora-covenant, and truthsystems-mod.
standards.falsifies_if: CROSS_REPO_INSTRUCTIONS.md does not exist or does not reference all three repository names
